purpose: Selective, self-contained vendoring of pure-doc skill playbooks from mattpocock/skills for offline reference. No upstream scripts/installers are run. Third-party text is copied byte-for-byte and not edited.

source.fetchMethod: public read-only shallow git clone to .tmp/upstream-mattpocock-skills; HEAD resolved via git log. No write/push to upstream.

declaredDependencies.reason: grill-me/SKILL.md is a trigger-only stub (disable-model-invocation: true) whose sole instruction is 'Call the Skill tool with grilling'; it contains no interview methodology. grilling is vendored as a pure-doc runtime body so grill-me is self-contained and runnable.

license.verified: Root LICENSE read and confirmed MIT; included verbatim.

projectRulesPriority.statement: Project AGENTS.md and its ADL decision-log entries are authoritative and override any vendored upstream skill guidance whenever they conflict.
upstreamSkillsDoNotGrant: writing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or any credential into the repo
git push --force or rewriting already-pushed history
modifying user-home, global, IDE, or shell config
running upstream installers / setup-matt-pocock-skills / one-click setup
skipping the project independent-test gating (ADL-045) or its GUI-evidence requirement
projectRulesPriority.conflictResolution: Where a vendored playbook suggests behavior the project forbids (offline-first, keys-not-in-repo, no-force-push, test gating, data/ stays out of git), the project rules win and the playbook is treated as reference only.

excludedArtifacts.reason: Upstream executable bash script. Policy forbids vendoring/running upstream scripts/installers. Audited but not copied: it is a benign terminal step/capture prompt template (set -euo pipefail; reads Enter/y-n into vars; prints KEY=VALUE). No credential exfiltration, no force push, no user-home writes, no network calls. Consequence: diagnosing-bugs' last-resort 'HITL bash loop' fallback is non-functional in this vendor; use a human-in-terminal checklist manually instead.

excludedArtifacts: All other skills under skills/{engineering,productivity,in-progress,misc,deprecated}/ (not in the vendored set)
.git/ metadata, .changeset/, .claude-plugin/, .github/, scripts/ (repo root), docs/, GLOSSARY.md, SCOPE.md, CHANGELOG.md, README.md, CLAUDE.md, package.json, package-lock.json
Any installers / setup skills (e.g. setup-matt-pocock-skills) — not run, not copied
